rubric.hook: Can the first 3 seconds pose an irresistible question? (0-5)
rubric.conflict: Mystery, suspense, a surprising decision or emotional conflict (0-5)
rubric.visual: Is the story told clearly in pictures, readable after a 9:16 crop? (0-5)
rubric.payoff: A satisfying reveal / twist / ending that fits in 60 s (0-5)
rubric.fit_60s: Can the arc be compressed to 45-60 s without lying about it? (0-5)

candidates.title: Sintel (2010, Blender Foundation, dir. Colin Levy)
candidates.synopsis: A lone girl rescues and raises a wounded baby dragon, Scales, until an adult dragon snatches it. She searches for years, finally reaches a dragon's lair, and kills the adult dragon that hesitated to kill her, then sees its wing scar: it was Scales, grown up. Her reflection shows she has grown up too. Scales' baby follows her as she leaves.
candidates.notes: Footage-verified in this run (277 shots analysed). Official 1080p/4K masters exist; the copy reachable from the restricted test network is a 512x292 re-encode (CC-BY permits redistribution). Credit: (c) copyright Blender Foundation | durian.blender.org. Logos/trademarks excluded from licence.

candidates.title: Night of the Living Dead (1968, dir. George A. Romero)
candidates.synopsis: Strangers barricade themselves in a farmhouse against the walking dead. Ben survives the night, only to be shot by the rescue posse who mistake him for a ghoul.
candidates.notes: US public domain because the original prints carried no copyright notice. Use an original-print scan: later restorations/colourisations may carry their own copyright. Not reachable from the test network (archive.org blocked).
